narrative: PSV lead the race for the title on 71%, still clear of Feyenoord on 13%.
SC Cambuur's relegation risk rose 17 points to 48%, the largest move of the week; AZ Alkmaar up 16, PEC Zwolle down 7, FC Utrecht down 6 followed, measured against the forecast of 2026-08-19.
At the other end, SC Cambuur are the most likely to go down at 48%.
